title: eupatorium agrigaudium
intro: Eupatorium agrigaudium, commonly known as Gravel Root, is a perennial plant native to North America. It is known for its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in treating various health issues. The health benefits of Gravel Root include its ability to alleviate kidney stones, reduce fever, and soothe digestive issues, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic effects. The bioactive constituents of Gravel Root include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
